text: Kasseri curd is left to acidify to about pH 5.2, then sliced and kneaded in hot water until it stretches. Kashkaval of the Balkans and kaşar of Turkey are the same kind of cheese.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: The curd is sliced and kneaded in hot water until it stretches to a 1 m thread.

steps.name: rest
steps.note: The cheese is kept in its moulds.

processing.text: The curd is left to acidify before it is stretched in hot water.
